params.name: start
params.description: Range start as an ISO 8601 date or epoch-milliseconds string. Defaults to 30 days ago.

params.name: end
params.description: Range end as an ISO 8601 date or epoch-milliseconds string. Defaults to now.

items.docs: Wallet spend report over a time range. Returns totals plus per-bounty and per-human breakdowns. Auth via API key or Firebase session; the wallet is resolved from the caller.
Read wallet controls (low-balance alert threshold, spending caps, auto-topup config) for the authenticated caller.
Update wallet controls. Send only the fields to change; pass null to clear a threshold or cap. When autoTopupEnabled is true, requires target > floor > 0 and maxPerDay >= target - floor.
